Forest test site

Forest keys test page

Everything happens in this tab. The seed and the keys live in memory only; nothing is sent anywhere unless you press the one button that says so. This page uses its own origin as the passkey's relying party; the real relying party is forest.foundation.

1. Passkey

Create once. Unlock as often as you like, and after a reload: the results must not change.

2. Name parameters

The did:plc is the hash of the genesis operation, which names both, so it changes when they change. The keys do not.

3. Seed and profiles

Seed fingerprint: not unlocked

4. Paper export

5. Create the DID at the directory (optional, permanent, public)

The only action on this page that leaves the tab. A DID cannot be deleted, and its record is public.

Log

The passkey's relying party here is this page's own origin, so a passkey made here opens nothing else. In Forest the relying party is forest.foundation. This is a test page, not a product.
